title: Art's Torches
description: Light your torches at the campfire and light another campfire with it.
body:
!["Art's Torches: Light My Fire" in Minecraft update style text, flames and torch textures.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f953b6f18e65f92189db51146fe93834feefbc1.png)
**Updated 21 June 2025. Works with 1.21.6; should work with all 1.21.x, but not guaranteed.**

If specific versions are needed, please join the Discord and ask in the data-pack-suggestions forum.
# Purpose
For immersion, the ability to relight a campfire with a torch is very handy, and it's very easy in real life to make a torch by putting a stick (or certain mushrooms) in a campfire.

# Directions for Use
1. Install the datapack.
2. Put down a campfire.
3. Put a stick, mushroom, or fungus on it just like you were cooking food.
4. Collect the torch when it's done.
5. Put out the campfire.
6. Drop the torch on the unlit campfire (defaults to "Q").
7. Collect the torch from your newly lit campfire.

# Known Issues
- No known issues.
